highlights: Revenues were 2.2% higher in the quarter, primarily driven by price increases of $78 million, contributions from acquisitions of $77 million, and surcharges of $23 million, partially offset by lower volumes and the unfavorable impact of foreign exchange and other revenues.
Net income was $558 million for the third quarter of 2026, or $1.02 per diluted share, compared with Net income of $540 million, or $0.98 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025.
Adjusted diluted earnings per share for the third quarter of 2026 was $1.05 compared to $1.05 in the third quarter of 2025.
Revenue growth of 3.6% in the third quarter of 2026 was primarily driven by higher volumes and pricing.

The decrease in cash provided by operating activities of $195 million was primarily driven by net working capital changes and the settlement of Spin-Off related balances in the prior period, partially offset by higher net income and non-cash expenses.
outlook: The company invested $262 million and $773 million in capital expenditures, net for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively, and expects to invest approximately $900 million in 2026 to expand production and increase operational efficiency to best serve customers.
